description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Displace by paying {3}, blinking Shipwreck Dowser and Deceiver Exarch.
Shipwreck Dowser and Deceiver Exarch enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deceiver Exarch trigger, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead activate Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.
